title: AltContext guided demo: copy, flow and state-contract review

audiences.product_role: A content editor reviewing alt text for the supplied festival gallery
audiences.constraint: The reviewer need not know these public figures or operate WordPress beyond reaching the supplied demo.

recommendation.decision: Retain the scenario; change the story from successful recognition to editorial control over an AI-assisted draft.
recommendation.primary_job: Understand the source, decide which suggested names to use, review text, apply locally, and reverse the application.
recommendation.career_value: Demonstrates product boundaries, uncertainty-aware interaction, accessibility work, and end-to-end craft. It does not by itself demonstrate customer discovery, model accuracy, production adoption or hiring likelihood.

reviewed: Current canon interaction, accessibility and selected writing rows
not_reviewed: App event handlers or backend source
Image identity, event metadata or licensing evidence

priority_meaning.P0: Required state/boundary guard before presenting the revised demo; a risk may require confirmation rather than being a proven runtime bug.
priority_meaning.P1: Needed for clear, usable review and credible product craft.
priority_meaning.P2: Useful supporting evidence; not a reason to expand the product before applying.

prohibited_claims: This audit logged in or tested the live demo
All shown identities or licenses were independently verified
A successful saved example establishes accuracy
An assisted confirmation is an independent identity judgment
Passing tests establishes full accessibility conformance
This patch improves hiring odds by a numerical amount

sources.scope: One DOM snapshot only; not source code, computed styles, screenshots, event handlers, network traces, or subsequent states.

canon_rules.title: Clear entry points
canon_rules.application: Keep the primary task obvious; put supplementary explanations behind disclosure.

canon_rules.title: Named step progress
canon_rules.application: Expose the ordered steps and the current position without confusing pipeline state with visitor progress.

canon_rules.title: URL restores place
canon_rules.application: Preserve the hash-router route when navigating within this page; this rule does not select navigation membership.

canon_rules.title: Consistent vocabulary
canon_rules.application: Use one term per object or action; distinguish alt text, a sample draft, and a separate live description.

canon_rules.title: Group by scope
canon_rules.application: Keep per-face choices with the evidence they affect; separate live experiments from demo application.

canon_rules.title: Clear final action
canon_rules.application: Make the local apply action the unmistakable end of review, adjacent to its preview.

canon_rules.title: Specific action labels
canon_rules.application: Name the target of apply, undo and reset; unavailable actions say why.

canon_rules.title: Preview before commitment
canon_rules.application: The displayed candidate must be exactly the text that the application action writes.

canon_rules.title: Wait state and cancellation
canon_rules.application: Show real progress, bound waiting, and offer an honest stop/cancel action according to actual backend capability.

canon_rules.title: Reversible edits
canon_rules.application: Keep reversible local applications; preserve manual draft revisions before replacement.

canon_rules.title: Predictable automation
canon_rules.application: Expose state and the next effect; an asynchronous result must not silently alter the reviewed candidate.

canon_rules.title: Preserve useful work
canon_rules.application: Keep usable edits when a dependency changes or a separate live request fails.

canon_rules.title: Inspectable supporting evidence
canon_rules.application: Let a reviewer inspect the observations and provenance behind a saved suggestion.

canon_rules.title: Correction reaches its source
canon_rules.application: A demo choice changes the demo source state, not just a caption; do not imply it trains or changes the server roster.

canon_rules.title: Disclose automation boundaries
canon_rules.application: Separate recorded recognition, browser-local editing, and live server generation; avoid claims beyond the observed envelope.

canon_rules.title: Assistance and correction modes
canon_rules.application: Allow omission and wording changes; state whether a task is assisted review rather than independent verification.

canon_rules.title: Generated output remains a proposal
canon_rules.application: Present sample and live text as drafts subject to editorial review.

canon_rules.title: Local verification cues
canon_rules.application: Keep evidence and editing beside the risky output instead of repeating generic reassurance throughout the page.

canon_rules.title: Independent judgment before reveal
canon_rules.application: A confirm-only flow with the answer already displayed cannot be described as independent identity verification.

canon_rules.title: Reference coverage
canon_rules.application: Make the available reference set inspectable; partial bundled coverage must be disclosed. Current three-reference display is a partial-coverage concern, not the literal single-reference trigger.

canon_rules.title: Validation level
canon_rules.application: Separate implementation checks, usability evidence, model accuracy, and job-market fit.

canon_rules.title: Decision-relevant measurement
canon_rules.application: Measure whether visitors understand and complete the demo, not whether they click every control.

canon_rules.title: Predeclared success
canon_rules.application: Write task pass/fail criteria before participant sessions.

canon_rules.title: Sampling uncertainty
canon_rules.application: Report n and uncertainty for headline estimates; do not turn a small-sample count into a population claim.

canon_rules.title: Sample matches the purpose
canon_rules.application: Use a small formative round for discovery, never as exhaustive validation.

canon_rules.title: Purposeful text alternatives
canon_rules.application: Explain the page-specific reason for alt text; keep the evidence image distinct from the applied demo image.

canon_rules.title: Associated input labels
canon_rules.application: Use fieldsets/legends and labels for face choices and the editable draft.

canon_rules.title: Named controls
canon_rules.application: Control names must identify what changes and where.

canon_rules.title: Non-color state
canon_rules.application: Choice, progress and readiness have text or semantic state beyond color.

canon_rules.title: Reflow and resize
canon_rules.application: Verify at narrow widths, zoom and changed text spacing; no visual conformance verdict is possible from this snapshot.

canon_rules.title: Keyboard task completion
canon_rules.application: The core demo, dialogs, evidence inspection and undo need complete keyboard paths.

canon_rules.title: Unobscured focus
canon_rules.application: Focus and scrolled headings must remain visible below the WordPress toolbar and guide.

canon_rules.title: No surprise navigation
canon_rules.application: Changing a face choice must not advance the page or move focus without an explicit navigation action.

canon_rules.title: Status announcements
canon_rules.application: Announce meaningful updates once; do not make the textarea or full history live.

canon_rules.title: Plain terms
canon_rules.application: Replace implementation jargon in the visitor path with its observable effect.

canon_rules.title: Stable terms
canon_rules.application: Do not rename the same saved object across the flow.

canon_rules.title: Remove repetition
canon_rules.application: Explain the model-to-name sequence once rather than in successive introductions.

canon_rules.title: Evidence for effects
canon_rules.application: Remove the uninspectable second-photo performance aside from this demo.

canon_rules.title: Resolvable evidence
canon_rules.application: Preserve actual source and case-study links; an HTTP success alone does not establish relevance or licensing.

canon_rules.title: Repair the cause
canon_rules.application: Fix split state and inflated claims before polishing their wording.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Use assisted editorial review rather than adding blind identity testing to this demo.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: The supplied case already names the people and shows labelled references. Hiding one label later cannot make the session independent. The visitor chooses whether to use a supplied suggestion in text, not whether to authenticate a person.
canon_scope_decisions.allowed_claim: Assisted review of saved name suggestions.
canon_scope_decisions.scope_limit: This exception does not approve confirm-only design for a consequential production identity-verification workflow. Such a workflow needs a separate design and evaluation.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Improve access to existing references and disclose missing bundled coverage.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: The snapshot already shows multiple references; do not claim a single-reference failure. Do not demand publication of unlicensed missing assets.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Choices update the local demo state and survive local re-render; they do not update the server roster.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: Do not add training/roster writes just to satisfy a rule intended for production correction loops.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Use it for the hash-route risk only.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: It does not require a Practice section, determine global navigation, or require sharing private local choices through the URL.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Preserve the editable draft and explicit local apply/undo boundary.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: Do not replace a useful review path with a read-only slideshow.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: Missing aria-controls on the current step disclosure is not a standalone WCAG failure.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: W3C APG describes aria-controls as optional. Test actual naming, expanded state, focus and reachability.

canon_scope_decisions.decision: All findings are a source-based expert review; every implementation test starts not_run.
canon_scope_decisions.rationale: HTML analysis cannot prove user comprehension, correctness of handlers, identity accuracy or full conformance.

findings.title: Separate the recorded demo from the independent live test
findings.problem: The page promises control over names and local changes, but the live test uses a different server roster and cannot update the draft being applied. Its artificial prerequisite implies a dependency it explicitly denies.
findings.required_change: Make the four-step recorded demo complete without live service. Move the live test to a collapsed optional panel after the outcome, label its independent inputs, and remove face-choice prerequisites. Opening the panel must not start a request. Do not connect live output to Apply in this pass.

findings.title: Apply must use the visible reviewed draft
findings.problem: The text says Apply writes a saved draft, but an editable textarea and a separate Save my edit action imply two versions. Apply is enabled before face decisions in this snapshot. This is not proof of an incorrect handler, but the contract is ambiguous.
findings.required_change: Remove intermediate Save my edit. Maintain one editable draft, an explicit preview version, and local applied text. The Apply handler must reject invalid/stale/unreviewed states and copy exactly the displayed draft, not an older saved fixture.

findings.title: Do not present suggestions as completed identities
findings.problem: Matched, done, strong and Yes, this is [name] frame two recorded suggestions as factual answers before the visitor acts. The absolute every face overstates this single example.
findings.required_change: Use Saved suggestion and an assisted editorial inclusion task. Keep undecided, include, and leave unnamed distinct. Remove the success tick before a visitor choice and retire every face. Apply the documented HAI-15 scope decision X01; do not call this independent verification.

findings.title: Give the visitor one short entry and a single step model
findings.problem: Entrance, workspace hero, pipeline list, face explanation, and guide all restate the sequence. The DOM contains both an entry and workspace; actual initial visibility is unknown. Pipeline progress and visitor progress use different step labels.
findings.required_change: Use one h1, one short boundary disclosure and four numbered steps. Start scrolls/focuses Step 1; it is not a second launch layer. Keep sections in document order so readers can inspect them without a modal tour.

findings.title: Do not overwrite the hash-router route with an in-page anchor
findings.problem: The skip link replaces the fragment used by the supplied #/guided-prototype route. A click handler might intercept this; none was provided.
findings.required_change: Use explicit in-page navigation buttons that scroll to and focus the existing section IDs while preserving the router hash. Do not encode editorial choices in the URL.

findings.title: Keep each face choice next to its evidence
findings.problem: Both decisions occur after both evidence cards. A 64px crop is the only supplied view of each detected region. The spatial cost cannot be measured from HTML, but the markup separates the question from its evidence.
findings.required_change: Move one native fieldset into each face article, following its evidence. Provide a keyboard-operable larger comparison using existing licensed images. Keep the source photo available for context.

findings.title: Disclose reference coverage without inventing extra assets
findings.problem: One person has all 2 reference images shown; the other has 3 of 5, with no supplied route to the other two. This is a partial reference set, not the literal one-reference trigger in HAI-17.
findings.required_change: Expose all existing distributable references if they are actually bundled. Otherwise state 3 of 5 references included in this demo and make those three inspectable. Preserve credits; do not download unverified replacements or imply missing references were reviewed.

findings.title: Handle changes without threatening or losing edits
findings.problem: The message tells everyone to save or discard edits before changing an answer; the snapshot contains no discard control and does not establish that an edit exists.
findings.required_change: Remove the standing warning. If a name change would replace a manually edited draft, show a focused confirmation with Cancel and an explicit replace action; save the prior revision locally before replacement. Do not change already applied text.

findings.title: Make alt-text purpose explicit rather than making naming the goal
findings.problem: The story defines success as two names reaching the description. The example page context is shown but does not explain when names are useful. The words description and alt text are used for different artifacts without a stable distinction.
findings.required_change: Frame the job as editing alt text for the supplied festival gallery. State that names are optional editorial context, not proof of a better description. Use Alt text draft for the editable sample and Live description for the separate server output.

findings.title: Make apply, undo and completion tangible
findings.problem: The initial markup describes local application but gives no evidence of a resulting preview or completion state. The existing photograph is an evidence image, not necessarily the application target.
findings.required_change: Add a distinct demo-image preview with alt bound to local applied text, a textual before/after, and Undo last application. Keep the evidence image unchanged. End with an accurate local result, not a production-save message.

findings.title: Preserve disclosures and use precise, brief wording
findings.problem: You already named assumes the visitor owns this roster, real GPU explains infrastructure instead of value, and the unbundled Coachella anecdote adds a performance claim the visitor cannot inspect.
findings.required_change: Say this demo's saved people and recorded example. Remove the unbundled-image aside and repeated reassurance. Retain the recorded-run date as fixture provenance, not as a new test performed in this review.

findings.title: Test accessible interaction, not just ARIA attributes
findings.problem: Labels, headings, tabindex targets, and live regions are present. This snapshot cannot establish focus behavior, disabled-state feedback, reflow, contrast, or what is spoken after actions.
findings.required_change: Retain semantic strengths and add stateful keyboard/screen-reader tests. Use aria-current=step for the active guide item and aria-expanded for disclosures. Add aria-controls where useful, but do not report its current absence as a WCAG failure.

findings.title: Bound the optional live test and label recovery honestly
findings.problem: Only the blocked initial live state is supplied. Endpoint behavior, timeout, cancellation, data transmission, retention and recovery are unknown.
findings.required_change: Keep live generation off the core path. Verify the existing endpoint and non-publication boundary before enabling the live action. Use explicit request states, a tested wait bound, and Stop waiting unless actual server cancellation exists. Ignore stale responses after reset or a later request.

findings.title: Expose design rationale without making another portfolio section
findings.problem: The demo explains recognition mechanics repeatedly but gives little compact explanation of the product decisions relevant to the target role.
findings.required_change: Add one closed Design notes disclosure after the result, with three short decisions: recorded evidence, optional names, and explicit reversible application. Preserve the existing case-study link. Do not add a Practice route, a hiring pitch in every step, or a speculative homeowner redesign.

findings.title: Validate comprehension before claiming the demo is effective
findings.problem: No visitor sessions or runtime results accompany this DOM snapshot. A saved match run and HTML lint are not usability or product-market evidence.
findings.required_change: Run the short formative protocol after implementation. Assess the difference between saved and live state, the meaning of unnamed, and where Apply writes. Do not measure celebrity recognition accuracy or infer Quartermaster hiring odds.

target_information_architecture.pattern: Single-page guided review with four numbered sections, not an overlay tutorial or an auto-advancing wizard.
target_information_architecture.navigation: Explicit buttons scroll/focus section headings, preserve #/guided-prototype and leave all state unchanged. Incomplete sections may be inspected; guards prevent unreviewed application.
target_information_architecture.primary_action_policy: One visually dominant next action per section; per-face selection uses neutral native radios. Live generation never competes with Apply.
target_information_architecture.supplementary_content: Use existing <details>/<summary> or tested disclosure patterns for credits, design notes, earlier drafts and the live test. No new /practice route.

A visible readiness sentence and Review the draft button

steps.purpose: Read and edit the sample alt text.
ui: Page context and photo inspectable without navigating away
Preview the change and Keep current alt text
Collapsed local Draft history only when revisions exist

ui: Distinct demo image whose alt is appliedAltText
Undo last application with local history
Accurate outcome and optional Design notes / Live test disclosures

copy_catalog.notes.apply: Drafting and applying are separate actions. The preview shows exactly what will change, and Undo restores the previous demo alt text.
copy_catalog.notes.scope: This prototype demonstrates the interaction. It does not establish recognition accuracy, user trust, or full accessibility conformance.

preserved_content.example_page_description: A photo gallery from the opening nights of the Tribeca Festival in New York, June 2026.
preserved_content.original_alt_text: Two people at a film festival.
preserved_content.unnamed_sample_text: A man in a black tuxedo and a woman in a white draped gown pose side by side at the Tribeca Festival. Her hand rests on his chest.
preserved_content.identity_caveat: These are names supplied by the example. This review does not identify people from images or independently verify the event, identity or asset licenses.
preserved_content.credit_policy: Retain the supplied image credits. Resolve original asset/source and licence URLs from existing project metadata before adding links; do not invent URLs or make a legal-compliance claim from this HTML.

copy_application_notes: This catalog is replacement interface prose, not saved model output. Preserve actual recorded sample text and provenance separately.
Render dynamic placeholders from verified state/metadata; never display unresolved braces.
Move page.live_scope near the boundary disclosure, but keep it secondary. It announces an optional server feature, not a core dependency.
The terms demo copy, alt text draft, saved suggestion and live description refer to different objects; do not swap them for stylistic variety.
Keep the larger visual description only where it supports evidence inspection; remove repeated copies elsewhere.
The date string is inherited from the supplied page and must agree with the actual fixture before release.
Do not expose a bare strength score or success tick as proof of identity. Actual raw scores may be in provenance only when their meaning and source are available.
Do not replace descriptive evidence-image alt with the deliberately weak original demo alt. The separate preview is the application target.

appliedAltText.initial: Two people at a film festival.

derived_guards.canPreview: namesDecided AND draftStatus == ready AND draftText != null AND trim(draftText).length > 0
derived_guards.canApply: canPreview AND previewedVersion == draftVersion AND draftText != appliedAltText AND pendingChoiceChange == null
derived_guards.canRestoreRevision: revision.choices == choices; otherwise offer copy-only recovery with the stated warning

state_machine.guard_semantics: Language-neutral logical expressions, not executable JavaScript. Match strings exactly. trim is for emptiness checks only: Apply copies the displayed string verbatim. Compare choices by the left/right enum values, not JavaScript object identity.

updates: Set activeStep to requested step; scroll/focus its heading without changing router hash
forbidden: Do not mutate choices, drafts, applied text, or live state
Do not mark unperformed decisions as complete

updates: If draftOrigin == visitor_edit, store only the proposed choice in pendingChoiceChange and ask for confirmation
Otherwise set the choice; if namesDecided resolve the matching recorded sample, increment draftVersion and invalidate previewedVersion
When either choice is undecided, candidate remains blocked
Set outcome=not_finished; do not change appliedAltText
forbidden: Never overwrite an edited draft without confirmation
Never call a roster write or recognition endpoint

updates: Append the current draft with its old choices to draftHistory before any replacement
Apply pending choice, clear pendingChoiceChange, resolve the matching recorded sample
Increment draftVersion; clear previewedVersion; set outcome=not_finished
Keep appliedAltText and applicationUndoStack unchanged
forbidden: Never relabel a human-written fallback as a recorded model run

updates: Clear pendingChoiceChange, retain all existing choices and draft text, return focus to the originating control
forbidden: No draft version or applied text change

updates: Set draftText to the textarea value, draftOrigin=visitor_edit, increment draftVersion, clear previewedVersion; set outcome=not_finished
forbidden: No separate hidden savedDraft version
No word filtering, entity insertion, truncation or automatic save to WordPress

updates: Set previewedVersion=draftVersion; set activeStep=apply; show exact candidate text beside appliedAltText
forbidden: No rewriting during preview

transitions.guard: canApply, checked inside handler as well as in the UI
updates: Push previous appliedAltText to applicationUndoStack
Set appliedAltText=draftText verbatim; bind it to the demo-image alt
Set outcome=applied; add browser-local history event and one short status announcement
forbidden: No WordPress media, roster, settings or user-preference write
No network or live generation dependency

updates: Pop one application record; restore previousAltText; update demo-image alt; announce restoration
Keep draft/choices; log the undo; derive current completion display from the restored image
forbidden: Do not alter the evidence image alternative or a server record

transitions.guard: Always allowed, including a blocked/missing sample
updates: Set outcome=kept; keep appliedAltText unchanged; preserve draft text; log a local event; show completion summary
forbidden: Do not label this as rejection training or send server feedback

updates: Archive the current manual draft if present; restore revision text as visitor_edit; increment draftVersion; clear previewedVersion; set outcome=not_finished
forbidden: Do not restore old choices silently
Do not apply the restored draft automatically

transitions.guard: The existing adapter contract has been checked, or its status is unknown
updates: Set liveContractVerified only from the verified integration configuration, not a visitor toggle
Use idle when verified and no request is pending; otherwise unavailable
forbidden: Do not probe with a billable request merely to render the panel
Do not infer capability from old planning documents or the presence of a button

updates: Disclose independent live scope and availability
forbidden: Do not start requests or provision GPU work

updates: Assign a new request token; clear previous live text; set pending; call the verified existing description endpoint once
forbidden: No dependency on choices or completed steps
No mutation of draftText, appliedAltText, applicationUndoStack or server roster
No new endpoint or payload fields invented from this brief

transitions.guard: Response token equals current token AND liveStatus == pending
updates: Set succeeded only for a nonempty valid result; otherwise failed; set liveText only in the read-only live panel
forbidden: Never copy into the demo candidate automatically
Ignore obsolete responses

updates: Stop local polling/request wait; invalidate the request token; use stopped or timed_out state and accurate copy
forbidden: Do not claim the server job was cancelled without an acknowledged server cancellation

transitions.guard: User confirms; no implicit reset on section navigation
updates: Restore core initial state and empty local histories; invalidate request token; stop local waiting; retain only verified live availability configuration
forbidden: Never change WordPress media
Do not claim remote work was stopped merely because local state reset

updates: Core demo state returns to initial values; server data is not changed
forbidden: No localStorage/sessionStorage persistence that contradicts the promised reload reset

fixture_contract.source: Locate and preserve existing sample fixtures; only the unnamed text is included in the supplied HTML.
fixture_contract.failure_behavior: If a required sample does not exist or its provenance cannot support recorded-sample wording, mark that variant fixture_missing. Keep current applied text. Do not invent saved model output. A clearly labelled manually authored variant requires a separately recorded content decision.
fixture_contract.manual_edit_boundary: Name choices select the sample text. A visitor can then rewrite it. Do not promise an identity allowlist on free text or add unsupported name detection to the editor.

work_items.title: Locate implementation and record actual contracts
instructions: Search the consumer checkout for acx-guided-page, guided-description-draft, guided-live-additive, and Apply to practice copy. Record actual files and symbols; do not guess a repository path.
Identify the route owner and whether the fragment link is intercepted.
Trace existing sample-variant selection, editor/save/apply state, reset/undo, and live adapter.
Verify whether core actions write server state; identify exactly what the live request sends/stores and whether cancellation is acknowledged.
Record the checked-out commit SHA, actual test commands, fixture provenance and unresolved blockers in implementation-evidence.json.
work_items.definition_of_done: Actual files/symbols and data boundaries are recorded. Unknown live contracts remain disabled; an inability to inspect the live backend does not block the recorded core.

work_items.title: Unify core draft and application state
instructions: Implement the state contract and handler guards.
Remove separate Save my edit from the core path.
Preserve all existing recorded variants, with a transparent missing-fixture state.
Add local revision history before destructive draft replacement.
Bind the distinct demo-image alt and textual applied value to the same state; support multiple local apply undos.
work_items.definition_of_done: Visible draft, preview and applied copy agree; edits survive replacement/cancel; tests prove no core server mutation.

work_items.title: Reflow entry, four steps and face evidence
instructions: Use one compact entry, one numbered guide, and the four sections in the specified order.
Preserve existing section IDs as focus targets; replace bare fragment navigation with in-page buttons that leave the router route intact.
Place each native face-choice fieldset inside its evidence article; no preselected name.
Replace confirm/strong/success language with an assisted inclusion decision; log X01 as the scope decision.
Provide inspectable bundled references and accurate counts; preserve assets and credits.
Remove duplicated introductions and the unbundled Coachella aside.
work_items.definition_of_done: A visitor can identify the next action and decide either person should remain unnamed without following a separate explanation track.

work_items.title: Isolate and harden optional live generation
instructions: Move the live panel after the core outcome; keep it closed by default but reachable without completing the core.
Do not use demo face choices as fake prerequisites; disclose the separate server roster.
Enable the action only after the existing endpoint contract is verified. Do not remove a working live feature solely because it was previously described as offline in older planning documents.
Use the existing non-publishing adapter. No promotion of live text into the apply flow in this pass.
Implement pending/error/empty/timeout/stop-waiting and stale-response protection using a request token. Derive actual wait limits from the service contract; never fabricate measured durations.
work_items.definition_of_done: Core works when live fails; live status and side effects are accurately described. If backend proof is unavailable, the optional test is explicitly unavailable, not simulated as live.

work_items.title: Complete semantic, keyboard and responsive verification
instructions: Use semantic headings, labelled fieldsets/radios, explicit focus targets and a distinct applied demo image.
Keep polite status messages short and emitted once; leave full text/history outside live regions.
Maintain focus after choices, restoration and dialogs; move it only with explicit step navigation.
Inspect the built page at narrow widths/zoom with the WordPress toolbar present.
Document manual screen-reader outcomes separately from automated accessibility results.
work_items.definition_of_done: The specified manual and automated checks have truthful run/not-run results; no full-conformance claim is made from passing DOM checks alone.

work_items.title: Add a restrained result and design-note layer
instructions: Show Applied or Kept outcome accurately with the visible local history.
Add one closed Design notes disclosure and retain the case-study link as an actual anchor.
Do not create a Practice section or new portfolio navigation.
Use the three notes to explain product decisions; keep recruitment mapping in the case study rather than interrupting the task.
work_items.definition_of_done: The reviewer can finish the task and then inspect rationale without reading a second sales page.

work_items.title: Integrate and hand off evidence
instructions: Run relevant unit/component/browser tests and content review from the actual checkout.
Use stubbed live requests for automated tests; request explicit approval before any paid live smoke run.
Capture built-page screenshots for the core steps and one failed live state; do not label mockups as runtime captures.
Return actual changed files, commit/patch references, executed commands, observed results and unrun checks. Follow existing repository workflow; do not push or merge without authorization.
work_items.definition_of_done: A reviewer can inspect the changed artifact and evidence. Assertions in the report correspond to actual runs, not intended commands.

work_items.title: Run one small formative study
instructions: Use the study protocol and record the actual participant count and backgrounds.
Collect incorrect mental models before explaining the intended answer.
Fix at least the high-impact problems observed; report changes only if they actually happened.
work_items.definition_of_done: Observed user behavior is documented separately from code-review evidence and any hiring judgment.

acceptance_tests.title: Core walkthrough is network-independent
acceptance_tests.given: Recorded fixtures available; description endpoint forced offline
acceptance_tests.when: Finish name choices, edit, preview, apply and undo
acceptance_tests.then: Core path succeeds with zero mutating network calls and zero description/recognition requests.

acceptance_tests.title: One coherent entry and four steps
acceptance_tests.given: Initial route loaded
acceptance_tests.when: Inspect visible headings, accessible names and step controls
acceptance_tests.then: One main h1 uses page.title; all four step names/ordinals are available; no pipeline item says identities are matched/done before a visitor choice; repeated old hero/how-it-works copy is gone.

acceptance_tests.title: All name-choice combinations and the unresolved state
acceptance_tests.given: Choices initially undecided/undecided
acceptance_tests.when: Exercise all four include/omit combinations and every one-undecided state
acceptance_tests.then: Neither radio starts selected; omit completes a choice; the exact matching sample loads only when both choices exist; preview/apply guards reject unresolved choices; per-face selected state is visible and programmatic.

acceptance_tests.title: Missing sample fails transparently
acceptance_tests.given: Remove include/omit sample in a test fixture
acceptance_tests.when: Choose include/omit
acceptance_tests.then: Show fixture-missing copy, keep applied text unchanged, preserve choices, disable preview/apply; no fake fallback and no live call. Keep current alt text remains available.

acceptance_tests.title: Apply copies visible text exactly
acceptance_tests.given: Both choices made and draft edited to a distinctive test sentence
acceptance_tests.when: Preview then apply
acceptance_tests.then: Applied text, textual preview and demo-image alt equal that sentence byte-for-byte; no stale sample is applied; no WordPress write occurs.

acceptance_tests.title: Repeated apply and undo
acceptance_tests.given: Apply draft A, then edit/preview/apply B
acceptance_tests.when: Undo once, then again
acceptance_tests.then: First undo restores A; second restores original alt text; controls prevent duplicate no-change applies; draft text remains available; undo disabled only when stack empty.

acceptance_tests.title: Manual draft survives a changed name choice
acceptance_tests.given: A distinctive manually edited draft exists
acceptance_tests.when: Request a different face option, first cancel; then request again and confirm
acceptance_tests.then: Cancel changes neither choice nor text. Confirm archives the old text/choices, loads the correct sample, invalidates preview, and never changes applied text.

acceptance_tests.title: Old previews cannot be applied
acceptance_tests.given: A draft has been previewed
acceptance_tests.when: Edit it or change its dependent name choices; invoke apply handler directly in a test
acceptance_tests.then: Handler rejects stale preview even if UI is bypassed in the test; applied text unchanged; a fresh preview makes current text eligible.

acceptance_tests.title: Leaving unnamed is an ordinary valid outcome
acceptance_tests.given: Both people included in one pass
acceptance_tests.when: Change the right choice to omit, then both to omit, with any edit-replacement confirmation handled
acceptance_tests.then: Correct samples reflect choices; omission is not an error, low score, failed step or server-roster deletion; visitor can finish and undo either branch.

acceptance_tests.title: Guide preserves route and user state
acceptance_tests.given: URL includes #/guided-prototype and a draft is partly edited
acceptance_tests.when: Use Start, guide items and back/next controls
acceptance_tests.then: Router remains on guided-prototype; no #guided-section-* replacement hash; draft and choices persist; focus moves only after explicit navigation; guide current-step state is accurate.

acceptance_tests.title: Keyboard and focus visibility
acceptance_tests.given: Keyboard-only operation; WordPress toolbar and step guide present
acceptance_tests.when: Complete the task, open comparison/history, cancel/reset dialogs, and navigate sections
acceptance_tests.then: No trap; visible focus; selected radios follow native behavior; dialogs return focus to their trigger; focused headings are not obscured; changing a radio does not auto-advance.

acceptance_tests.title: References are inspectable and honestly counted
acceptance_tests.given: Reference assets as shipped
acceptance_tests.when: Open each comparison using keyboard
acceptance_tests.then: Left coverage says all 2 only if 2 are present; right says 3 of 5 included unless the extra two are actually supplied; no fake Show all 5; image credits persist; enlarged view is usable and dismissible.

acceptance_tests.title: Draft-history restore respects name dependencies
acceptance_tests.given: Earlier edit has different choices from current
acceptance_tests.when: Attempt to restore it, then copy it; repeat with matching choices
acceptance_tests.then: Mismatched restore is blocked with exact explanatory text, copy is allowed; matching restore invalidates preview and does not apply; previous manual text is retained.

acceptance_tests.title: Live panel is optional and inert when opened
acceptance_tests.given: Initial or partially completed recorded walkthrough
acceptance_tests.when: Open live disclosure with no identity decisions
acceptance_tests.then: No request starts; live availability is not gated by face choices. If contract is unverified, live action remains unavailable with explicit explanation.

acceptance_tests.title: Live request is isolated
acceptance_tests.given: Verified endpoint adapter stub and distinctive draft/applied values
acceptance_tests.when: Start live generation after declining both names
acceptance_tests.then: Exactly one live request uses the existing verified server contract; it is not represented as honoring demo choices; result appears read-only; draft/applied/undo/core progress unchanged.

acceptance_tests.title: Pending, failure, empty response, timeout and retry
acceptance_tests.given: Controlled fake live adapter and fake timers
acceptance_tests.when: Exercise pending, failure, empty payload, time bound and retry
acceptance_tests.then: Real state labels render; duplicate request disabled while pending; no invented percentage; retry creates a new request token; core text and history unchanged; timeout never implies server cancellation.

acceptance_tests.title: Reset and stale results
acceptance_tests.given: A live request is pending and the core demo has changed
acceptance_tests.when: Confirm reset, then resolve the old request
acceptance_tests.then: Core resets to initial values; no late output overwrites either workspace; local wait is stopped; accurate warning covers potential continuing server job.

acceptance_tests.title: Payload and storage boundary
acceptance_tests.given: Core flow plus isolated live adapter
acceptance_tests.when: Exercise every control
acceptance_tests.then: Capture network destinations/methods and browser storage writes. Core state uses no publishing, roster or storage write. Only explicit live activation may use the allowed existing endpoint. Never log credentials or paste secrets into snapshots.

acceptance_tests.title: Evidence image differs from applied demo image
acceptance_tests.given: Source photo has a stable descriptive alternative
acceptance_tests.when: Apply and undo
acceptance_tests.then: Only the separate data-testid=demo-applied-image alt tracks appliedAltText. The evidence image remains descriptive; visible current-text output changes with the demo preview. No aria-label overrides the demo image alt.

acceptance_tests.title: Reflow, comparison layout and disclosure
acceptance_tests.given: 320 CSS-pixel width, 200% zoom, text-spacing override and desktop viewport
acceptance_tests.when: Complete the demo and inspect comparisons/disclosures
acceptance_tests.then: No action or text becomes unreachable; evidence and choices remain associated; native control targets are usable; expanded state matches visibility. Measure contrast rather than inferring it from class names.

acceptance_tests.title: Announcements are useful and not duplicated
acceptance_tests.given: Actual screen reader with keyboard
acceptance_tests.when: Change choices, apply, undo, receive live result and reset
acceptance_tests.then: Relevant update is announced once without reading the entire draft or history. Input does not continuously trigger live announcements. A disclosed hidden panel has no stray tabbable controls.

acceptance_tests.title: Completion demonstrates an outcome
acceptance_tests.given: A valid draft and an unchanged demo copy
acceptance_tests.when: Finish once by Apply and once by Keep current alt text
acceptance_tests.then: Accurate outcome appears with Return to the draft, local action history, case study and closed optional panels. No forced live test, invented completion time, production-save claim or job-application CTA.

acceptance_tests.title: Live network contract gate
acceptance_tests.given: The live endpoint and existing adapter are located
acceptance_tests.when: Inspect request fields, destination, authentication, response, persistence and cancellation behavior
acceptance_tests.then: Evidence record is completed. If non-publication/data-boundary checks fail or remain unknown, liveContractVerified stays false. No change is made to access controls or backend capabilities to force a green demo.

acceptance_tests.title: Links, provenance and credits survive
acceptance_tests.given: Existing assets and case-study link
acceptance_tests.when: Build the modified page
acceptance_tests.then: The existing case-study anchor remains a real link to the same destination; source/credit links resolve to relevant existing records when available; no invented credits, reference images, IDs or licensing approvals.

acceptance_tests.title: Claims discipline
acceptance_tests.given: New copy rendered in all states
acceptance_tests.when: Search strings and manually read the result
acceptance_tests.then: No every face, real GPU, success claim for the unbundled photo, independent verification claim, or use of strong as proof. Saved example is distinguished from live output. All placeholders resolve before rendering.

acceptance_tests.title: Formative comprehension study
acceptance_tests.given: 3-5 participants with declared relevant experience; at least one content editor and one design/product reviewer; accessibility coverage reported honestly
acceptance_tests.when: Run the study protocol in the brief without explaining the answers first
acceptance_tests.then: Report raw task outcomes, mistakes and changes made; separate guided completion from unguided understanding; no fabricated percentage improvement or inference about model accuracy/hiring probability.

formative_study.goal: Determine whether a new visitor understands the three state boundaries and can complete/reverse the editorial task.

suggested_participants.purpose: Small formative discovery, not inference about a population.
suggested_participants.recruitment: Relevant content editors and product/design reviewers. Include an actual assistive-technology user when claiming that coverage; otherwise state it was not tested.

tasks.prompt: Before starting, explain what you expect to happen and what is live.
tasks.success: Distinguishes recorded face suggestions from optional server generation; does not expect recognition to run on Start.

tasks.prompt: Use one suggested name and leave the other person unnamed. Review the resulting text.
tasks.success: Completes both choices without interpreting unnamed as an error; correctly predicts its effect on the sample draft.

tasks.prompt: Change the wording and apply it. Tell me where you think it was saved.
tasks.success: The chosen text reaches the local demo copy, and participant correctly says it did not publish WordPress media.

tasks.prompt: Return the demo image to its previous alt text.
tasks.success: Finds and uses Undo without resetting the whole walkthrough.

tasks.prompt: Open the optional live test. Before starting it, explain whether your earlier name choices control it.
tasks.success: Recognizes the separate server roster and that live text will not replace the reviewed draft.

critical_misunderstandings: Believes unnamed changes the server roster
Believes the live result will be applied automatically
formative_study.release_use: Any observed critical misunderstanding triggers a copy/flow review before presenting the revised version. A small all-pass sample does not prove no misunderstandings remain.
formative_study.measurement_notes: Use raw counts and participant context. If publishing headline rates, attach n and a suitable interval. Avoid speed claims from concurrent think-aloud sessions. Never call this a face-recognition accuracy test.

quartermaster_evidence_mapping.demo_evidence: Saved suggestion, optional naming and separate live result
quartermaster_evidence_mapping.limit: Does not prove model quality or homeowner trust.

quartermaster_evidence_mapping.demo_evidence: One task with review, preview, local application and undo
quartermaster_evidence_mapping.limit: Still a prototype, not evidence of a shipped production feature.

quartermaster_evidence_mapping.demo_evidence: Three short decision notes linked to the actual interaction
quartermaster_evidence_mapping.limit: Do not present the canon as external user research.

quartermaster_evidence_mapping.demo_evidence: Keyboard-operable decisions and truthful status/preview behavior
quartermaster_evidence_mapping.limit: Conformance requires broader testing than this snapshot.

quartermaster_evidence_mapping.demo_evidence: Document a real revision after the proposed study
quartermaster_evidence_mapping.limit: Only add outcomes after the study has happened.

out_of_scope: New roster writes or model training
Automatic promotion of live output into the core draft
New React/TypeScript inventory scanner or Canvas product release
Changing the photograph or inventing another recognition result
Removing WordPress authentication or altering browser security policy
Mass visual redesign before the core boundary/flow fixes
Publishing invented latency, accuracy, user-research or hiring-impact metrics

rules: No claim of completion without an inspectable changed artifact.
Do not report intended commands as executed tests.
Do not write credentials into the implementation report.
Keep proposed names and future capability separate from shipped behavior.
Follow the repository's approved branch workflow; do not alter unrelated work.

implementation_execution_policy.default: Sequential implementation in the current consumer checkout; this brief does not authorize background agent jobs.
implementation_execution_policy.parallelism: Split only after W00 identifies disjoint files and shared contracts. Do not assign two lanes to the same component or reducer.
implementation_execution_policy.browser_testing: Use an already authorized browser or local test environment. Do not modify managed browser policies or access controls.
implementation_execution_policy.live_testing: Automated tests use a stub. A billable real generation needs explicit authorization and a verified non-publication contract.
implementation_execution_policy.change_budget: Limit changes to this guided route, its local state/helpers, existing live adapter integration, fixtures, relevant tests and case-study link. No new backend feature is required.
